name: livemarkets
description: Sixty-second onchain prediction markets. One question, nineteen price levels, all of them matching at once.

scripts.deploy: cd packages/contracts && forge script script/Deploy.s.sol:Deploy --rpc-url monad_testnet --broadcast --slow -vvv
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:math && npm run test:width && npm run test:model
scripts.vectors: cd packages/contracts && python3 sim/gen_vectors.py && forge test --mt test_writeVectors
scripts.hooks:install: git config core.hooksPath scripts/git-hooks && echo 'hooks installed: scripts/git-hooks'
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @livemarkets/web run typecheck && npm -w @livemarkets/cranker run typecheck && npm -w @livemarkets/indexer run typecheck
